ShaderNodePreset.Description: Dual-illuminant white balance using a Bradford chromatic adaptation transform (not naive channel gains). Global Temperature/Tint plus independent shadow and highlight white balance to fix mixed lighting in one node. Color-space aware.
ShaderNodePreset.Name: BB_WhiteBalance

Uniform.Tooltip: Input color space - sets gamma decode, primaries and neutral for the adaptation
Uniform.Name: colorSpace

Uniform.Tooltip: Temperature: positive warms the image (counters a blue cast), negative cools it
Uniform.Name: temp

Uniform.Tooltip: Tint: positive adds magenta, negative adds green (perpendicular to the Planckian locus)
Uniform.Name: tint

Uniform.Tooltip: Mix the corrected result with the original
Uniform.Name: strength

Uniform.Tooltip: Neutral sampler: sample a colour that should be neutral grey/white (use the swatch eyedropper on the image); the image is balanced so that colour reads neutral. Temperature/Tint still trim on top.
Uniform.Name: pickerEnable

Uniform.Tooltip: Sample a colour that should be neutral (swatch eyedropper), or set it manually
Uniform.Name: pickerColor

Uniform.Tooltip: Enable independent white balance for shadows and highlights (mixed-lighting fix)
Uniform.Name: dualEnable

Uniform.Tooltip: Luminance level that splits shadows from highlights
Uniform.Name: splitPivot

Uniform.Tooltip: Softness of the shadow / highlight transition
Uniform.Name: splitSoftness

Uniform.Tooltip: Temperature offset applied to the shadows (added to global)
Uniform.Name: shadowTemp

Uniform.Tooltip: Tint offset applied to the shadows (added to global)
Uniform.Name: shadowTint

Uniform.Tooltip: Temperature offset applied to the highlights (added to global)
Uniform.Name: highTemp

Uniform.Tooltip: Tint offset applied to the highlights (added to global)
Uniform.Name: highTint
